programs.title: Awara Paagal Deewana
programs.desc: A henpecked husband and his father-in-law are intrigued by their new neighbour Gulab Khatri, a recluse and mysterious man. They unwittingly get embroiled in a mafia rivalry when they find out that he's a wanted criminal.

programs.title: Love Sex Aur Dhoka
programs.desc: An Indian anthology film that tells three separate but interconnected stories revolving around the themes of love, sex, and betrayal. The film is shot in a found-footage style, utilizing surveillance cameras, mobile phones, and webcams to capture the stories of individuals from different backgrounds, whose lives are intertwined in unexpected ways. It explores the dark side of relationships and the impact of technology on modern romance.

programs.title: Dus
programs.desc: Jambval, a terrorist, plans to wreak havoc in Canada during Indian PM's visit there. Now, Siddharth, the head of the Indian Anti-Terrorist Squad, must lead his team to uproot Jambval's plans and apprehend dreaded terrorist.
